meta.name: iHuman
meta.description: iHumanis about artificial intelligence, social control, and power. It shows how this technology is changing dominant culture. The constant surveillance via phones, Internet devices, and social systems is the crucial foundation for the development of AI, so the question is posed, are we already are governed by algorithms that are created by big tech corporations, governments and the military industry? The result is a profiling of Palantir Technologies, Cambridge Analytica, China’s Social Credit System, Google’s Project Maven and its close relationship with the United States military, along with Amazon, Microsoft, IBM. All of this together forms the existential risk from ‘Artificial General Intelligence.’
